title: Roasted Pepper and Almond Romesco
summary: Grilled tomatoes and roasted peppers blended with toasted almonds, bread, garlic, smoked paprika and olive oil.

ingredients.item: roasted red peppers from a jar, drained
thick slice white bread, toasted and torn
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Char the tomatoes
steps.text: Grill the tomatoes on the lined tray under a high grill for 3-4 min on each side until blackened in spots. Cool, then peel and core.

steps.title: Grind the nuts
steps.text: Pulse the garlic in the food processor, then add the almonds, bread, paprika and chilli flakes and pulse to coarse crumbs.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Add the tomatoes, peppers, vinegar, salt and parsley and pulse. With the motor running, drizzle in the oil until the sauce is thick with a little texture.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon alongside grilled spring onions, roasted vegetables, chicken or fish.

tips: Toast the almonds until golden for the deepest flavour.
Leave the sauce slightly coarse rather than puréed.
Add a splash of water if it is too thick.
Hazelnuts can replace some of the almonds.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 5 days; bring to room temperature before serving. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
